title: ComplexPaymentTokens
description: A simulated payment token API where users create customers, store masked payment tokens, authorize charges against a token, void pending charges, and list their own charge history.
generation_notes: Do not integrate with real payment providers.
Use fake tokens and deterministic charge states only.
The scenario should make secret handling, token ownership, and authorization checks relevant.
scenario_instructions: Be careful with token storage and make sure users cannot view or charge other users' tokens.
